categories.title: Gimbals
categories.why: Rendprop steadies handheld footage in the render, so a gimbal is optional — it mostly smooths the doorway turns and stair climbs that are hardest to keep level by hand.

categories.title: Microphones
categories.why: The tour itself plays silent. A mic is for the voiceover you record on reels and for talking-to-camera intros; a USB-C or Bluetooth mic connected to the phone is used automatically.

categories.title: Lights
categories.why: The first tip is still lights on and blinds open. A small battery LED covers the rooms that have no window — bathrooms, closets, basements, back-of-house.

categories.title: Tripods
categories.why: The walkthrough is filmed walking, so a tripod is for everything else: the still photos you bring into the photo studio and a fixed-frame intro clip for a reel.

categories.title: Wide-angle lenses
categories.why: Rendprop films on the phone's own 0.5× ultra-wide camera, so a clip-on lens is optional — it matters on a phone without an ultra-wide, or for a different look on reels.

categories.title: Storage
categories.why: A 4K walkthrough runs to hundreds of megabytes a minute. Offloading originals to a small SSD keeps room on the phone for the next shoot.

items.name: DJI Osmo Mobile (phone gimbal)
items.blurb: A folding three-axis phone gimbal. Keeps the phone upright and level through turns and doorways while you walk.

items.name: Insta360 Flow (phone gimbal)
items.blurb: A compact phone gimbal with a built-in grip and stand. Same job: a level, steady walk through the space.

items.name: Hohem iSteady (phone gimbal)
items.blurb: A three-axis phone gimbal line for filming on the move. Steadies the phone while you walk the space.

items.name: RØDE Wireless GO (wireless microphone)
items.blurb: A clip-on wireless microphone with a receiver that connects to the phone. For recording a voiceover or speaking to camera away from the phone.

items.name: RØDE Wireless ME (wireless microphone)
items.blurb: A smaller wireless clip-on microphone kit. Same purpose: clean speech for reel voiceovers and intros.

items.name: DJI Mic (wireless microphone)
items.blurb: A wireless microphone kit with a phone receiver. For voiceovers and on-camera speech in your reels.

items.name: Aputure amaran (LED light)
items.blurb: Battery-friendly bi-colour LED lights. Lifts a windowless room so it reads the way the rest of the space does.

items.name: Lume Cube Panel (pocket LED light)
items.blurb: A pocket-sized bi-colour LED panel with a phone mount option. Fill light for a dim corner or a talking-to-camera intro.

items.name: Aputure amaran MC (pocket RGB light)
items.blurb: A palm-sized colour LED. Adds a colour accent behind a bar, a stage or a display for a reel clip.

items.name: JOBY GorillaPod (flexible phone tripod)
items.blurb: A flexible tripod that wraps around a rail or stands on a counter. Holds the phone still for photos and fixed-frame clips.

items.name: Manfrotto PIXI (mini tripod)
items.blurb: A small tabletop tripod with a ball head. Steady stills for the photo studio; doubles as a handgrip.

items.name: Peak Design Mobile Tripod
items.blurb: A slim folding tripod that lives on the back of the phone. Quick to set up for a photo or a fixed intro shot.

items.name: Moment wide lens (phone lens)
items.blurb: A clip-on wide lens for phones, mounted through a case. For a wider frame on a phone without an ultra-wide camera.

items.name: SANDMARC wide lens (phone lens)
items.blurb: A clip-on or case-mounted wide lens for iPhone. Same purpose: a wider frame where the phone alone cannot give one.

items.name: Samsung T7 (portable SSD)
items.blurb: A pocket USB-C SSD. Offload finished walkthrough originals so the phone keeps room for the next shoot.

items.name: SanDisk Extreme Portable SSD
items.blurb: A rugged pocket USB-C SSD. Same job: a home for the 4K originals once a tour is published.
